summary: Klépierre SA is the European leader in shopping malls, with exclusive focus on continental Europe. The Company's portfolio is valued at 21.8 billion euros on June 30, 2026, and comprises large shopping centers in more than 10 countries in Continental Europe which together host more than 720 million visitors per year. These distinctions underscore the Group's commitment to a proactive sustainable development policy and its global leadership in the fight against climate change. Klépierre SA was established and incorporated on November 2009 in France.
